model.name: diagram.moveView
model.description: R33.3 (AC-movable-persist / INV-S33V-2, the BIG ROCK): RbDiagramDetail.wireBoxDrag makes each .dm-box MOVABLE - a pointer/touch drag on a box live-moves it and updates its view-link x,y, disambiguated from RbPanZoom canvas-pan (drag on .dm-box = move-box; drag on empty surface = pan), touch+mouse (the R32.11-MOBILE lesson: HTML5 DnD != touch -> pointer/touch events). The move persists via the server POST /api/model/diagram/move-view (inline endpoint glue, MODEL_STORE, INV-S33V-4) so it survives reload; a box-drag-end suppresses the trailing select click. Distinct NEW Method wireBoxDrag on Class RbDiagramDetail (no re-credit of addView/render). Gate = @390 pixel (drag -> SEE box move + persist).
